description: Save up to 100 people that search_prospects or find_contact_details returned (each by its profile_url) to one of the customer's lists. Uses no lookup credit. A list name that does not exist yet creates the list. A list holds people for later; it does not add them to the CRM.

list_name.description: the name of a list to save to; it is created when it does not exist

people.description: the people to save, up to 100, each with the profile_url that search_prospects or find_contact_details returned in this conversation

company.description: the person's company, for the customer's reference; the stored record is used

name.description: the person's full name, for the customer's reference; the stored record is used

profile_url.description: link to the person's public profile page, exactly as search_prospects or find_contact_details returned it

title.description: the person's job title, for the customer's reference; the stored record is used

name: save_to_list
title: Save people to a list
